description: Show an interactive timer that paces one named breathing technique for calm, focus or sleep. It is a relaxation exercise, not medical treatment. Use it when the user asks for a specific technique now, such as box breathing, 4-7-8, cyclic sighing, extended exhale, a 4-8 slow exhale, humming bee breath or alternate nostril breathing. The user presses Start in the timer. Nothing is saved and no account is needed.

minutes.description: Session length in minutes: 1, 2, 3, 5 or 10. Defaults to 1.

pattern.description: Which rhythm to pace. box: box breathing, 4-4-4-4, for focus. triangle: 4-7-8 breathing, for winding down to sleep. exhale: extended exhale, 3-2-6-2, to unwind. sigh: cyclic sighing, two inhales then one long exhale (3-1-6), to calm down fast. nadi: alternate nostril breathing (Anulom Vilom), 4-2-4 on each side. coherent: an even 4-2-4-2 rhythm, for steady calm (the rhythm of Vayu's guided pauses). slow_exhale: 4-8 slow exhale with no holds, for a panic moment or lying in bed. hum: humming bee breath (Bhramari), breathe in 4, hum out 6, to quiet a busy mind.

name: start_breathing_session
title: Start a breathing session
